verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-sharing app. Remote-access products can plausibly expose API credentials, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers device pairing and removing paired devices, which is an adjacent control rather than scoped API credentials for an agent. Probes found no API surface (openapi and llms.txt both 404), so there is no evidence of issuing least-privilege credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
